commentary_segments.text_raw:
In this Chapter, an overview
is given of the techniques
which are available to
reduce the supply voltage
and the power consumption
in sigma-delta converters.
The main problem at low
supply voltages is the input
sampling switch and the
increase of the distortion.
This can be remedied by the
switched-opamp technique
and also by a number of
clever circuit techniques.
They have all been dis-
cussed and compared for a
generally accepted FOM.
commentary_segments.text: In this Chapter, an overview is given of the techniques which are available to reduce the supply voltage and the power consumption in sigma-delta converters. The main problem at low supply voltages is the input sampling switch and the increase of the distortion. This can be remedied by the switched-opamp technique and also by a number of clever circuit techniques. They have all been discussed and compared for a generally accepted FOM.
